title: Fighter flags
description: data/rules/flags.json: the game-wide fighter flags (ADR-0023), such as stances and installs. A flag's bit is its place in the list, so add new flags at the end. Moves require, set and clear them by name; modules name the ones they use. Developer settings. Editor aid only: Sim.Data's validator is authoritative (src/Sim.Data/Rules).

clearedWhenHit.description: A fighter loses the flag when it is hit or thrown (e.g. knocked out of a stance).
